expectations.text: Explicitly identifies importing/instantiating the adapter directly inside routes.ts as a layering/architecture problem, not just a style nit
expectations.evidence: Opens by naming it "red flag №1" from the skill, with a 4-point explanation

expectations.text: Proposes moving the GitHub call into a service method (e.g. on PullsService) instead of the route
expectations.evidence: Shows PullsService.getPrStatus(prId) calling container.github(), with routes.ts reduced to calling pullsService.getPrStatus(...)

expectations.text: Suggests obtaining the client via container.github() (or an equivalent container-resolved interface) instead of `new OctokitGitHubClient(...)`
expectations.evidence: "await this.container.github()" inside the proposed service method

expectations.text: Describes or shows the resulting route reduced to param handling + service call + response mapping, with no adapter import left in routes.ts
expectations.evidence: Final routes.ts sample only calls pullsService.getPrStatus and serializes the result
